title: The Thorn of the Glass Steppe Revisited
author: Xanthe Montrose
blurb: Odile Dravenmoor, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
